# Ghostly

> Ghostly is a voice-first typing app for macOS. It lives in the menu bar: press a shortcut, talk, and your words land in the active app. Speech-to-text runs on-device using Whisper — audio never leaves the Mac. Optional AI cleanup (Apple Intelligence, OpenAI, Anthropic) polishes the transcript; only text is sent, never audio. Ghostly also transcribes meetings live without joining the call, and can run hands-free with Open Mic.

Ghostly is Apple Silicon only — macOS 12+ on any Mac with an M1 chip or later. Intel Macs are not supported. This is a deliberate decision: Ghostly runs every AI model on-device (Whisper via Metal, optional Apple Intelligence cleanup via the Neural Engine), and real-time local transcription needs the unified memory and ML accelerators that only Apple Silicon has. The app is distributed as a signed `.dmg` and requires microphone and accessibility permissions. First launch downloads a Whisper model (500 MB–1.6 GB depending on variant: Small, Medium, Turbo, Large).

## Key facts

- Platform: Apple Silicon only (M1 or later) on macOS 12 or later — Intel Macs not supported
- Pricing: Free tier is uncapped and full-featured — unlimited dictation on every Mac you own, all engines (Whisper, Parakeet, Moonshine), Meeting Mode, Open Mic, per-app prompts, screenshot vision. The AI features run on a user-supplied API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq, Ollama) or on-device Apple Intelligence. Ghostly Max is the optional paid tier: $12/month or $108/year, hosted AI with no API key and no setup, plus Max-only features (ask-your-transcripts, vocabulary learning, encrypted sync). Max is in early access and not yet purchasable.
- Privacy: On-device transcription. No analytics. No telemetry. Audio never transmitted.
- Download: https://downloads.try-ghostly.com/Ghostly-latest.dmg

## Modes

- Dictate: hold a global shortcut, talk, release. The cleaned transcript is pasted where the cursor is. A separate Verbatim shortcut transcribes with no rewriting at all.
- Meeting Mode: live transcription of a call in a floating panel, capturing both your microphone and the call's audio through a macOS process tap. No bot joins the meeting and no screen recording permission is needed. Capturing the other participants requires macOS 14.2 or later; below that Ghostly transcribes your side only. Speakers are labelled and renameable. Auto-connect is off by default and can be excluded by meeting name. Transcripts stay on the Mac, are never written to logs or diagnostics bundles, and are deleted after a chosen retention period.
- "Where were we?": an on-demand catch-up summary of the meeting in progress — what is being discussed now, what was missed, decisions made, anything asked of you, and one line you could say to rejoin. Generated on-device with Apple Intelligence, through your own AI provider, or extractively with no AI.
- Open Mic: hands-free dictation. The mic stays armed and each pause closes a segment, which is transcribed and inserted. Ending a segment with the submit phrase ("send it" by default) strips the phrase and presses Enter or Cmd+Enter. Off by default.

## Other features

- Per-app writing styles matched on the real bundle identifier — casual in Slack, formal in Mail, verbatim in an editor.
- Agent detection: in Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex and similar apps, Ghostly switches to local deterministic cleanup so a dictated prompt is punctuated but never reworded.
- Edit what you just said: revise the previous output by voice, or with shortcut chips (shorten, lengthen, fix grammar, rephrase).
- Screenshot + dictate: captures the screen alongside a spoken question and stages both for any AI chat that accepts images.
- Voice commands mapped to keystrokes, plus a configurable "scratch that" phrase for self-correction.
- Personal dictionary for names, products, and jargon, including how they sound versus how they are spelled.
- Notes and a Meetings library, both stored on-device: full-text search, tags, date and app grouping, and export as Markdown, plain text, or JSON.
- Swappable engines: Whisper by default, with Parakeet and Moonshine available.

## How it works

1. Press and hold a global shortcut (default: `fn`).
2. Speak. Silero VAD filters silence; audio is buffered locally.
3. Release the shortcut. Whisper transcribes on-device using Metal acceleration.
4. Resulting text is pasted into the currently active app via the system clipboard.
5. Optional: post-processing (AI cleanup) rewrites the transcript for tone or grammar before paste.

## Common questions

- Does audio leave the Mac? No. Transcription is on-device. AI cleanup only sees text.
- Is it free? Yes, and uncapped — unlimited dictation, every feature, on as many Macs as you own. AI features use your own API key. Ghostly Max ($12/month) is optional: the same AI with no key required, plus Max-only features. Max is in early access.
- Does it work offline? Yes, after first-run model download.
- Windows, Linux, or Intel Mac? No — Apple Silicon only (M1 or later). The AI models run on-device via Metal and the Neural Engine, and Intel hardware can't keep up without shipping audio off the machine, which defeats the privacy model.
- Apple Intelligence support? Yes, as an on-device AI cleanup option, and as an on-device backend for meeting summaries.
- Does a bot join my meetings? No. Meeting Mode captures audio locally on the Mac; nothing appears in the participant list.
